ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 Revision, effective 1 January 2025); Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Supervision and Administration of Beneficial Owners of Legal Persons and Other Organizations (Order No. 3 of the People's Bank of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation, effective 1 November 2024); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024); Measures for the Implementation of the Administrative Rules for Enterprise Name Registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the ultimate foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar or companies registry in the jurisdiction of the foreign parent (e.g., ACRA, HK Companies Registry, Delaware Division of Corporations, UK Companies House)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille route (if the issuing state is party to the Hague Apostille Convention): notarization by a qualified local notary, then a single apostille issued by the competent authority of the issuing state; consular legalization is not required. Consular legalization route (if the issuing state is not a party to the Apostille Convention): notarization by a local notary, then authentication by the home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalization by the Embassy/Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that state. The two routes are mutually exclusive and must never be combined sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of companies or authorised corporate service provider in the foreign parent's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille route (if Apostille Convention member): notarize and apostille by the competent issuing-state authority; no Chinese consular step. Consular route (if non-member): notarize, authenticate through the home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalize at the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in that jurisdiction. Mutual exclusivity applies.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing formation of the WFOE and naming its legal representative and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign parent company, notarized by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the state of notarization is an Apostille Convention member: notary certificate plus apostille from the competent authority; no consular legalization. If non-member: notary certificate plus foreign ministry authentication plus Chinese consular legalization. One path only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Association of the foreign parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or constitutional document custodian in the foreign parent's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille route (if member state): certified true copy notarized and apostilled; stop. Consular route (if non-member state): certified true copy notarized, home MFA authentication, and PRC Embassy/Consulate legalization; stop. Do not chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed relationship bank maintaining the foreign parent's active current account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille route (if the issuing bank operates in an Apostille Convention state): bank officer signature notarized by a local notary and apostilled by the competent authority; no consular legalization. Consular route (if non-member): bank officer signature notarized, home MFA authentication, PRC consular legalization. This is an alternative, never an addition to apostille.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Prior to filing, every director, shareholder, beneficial owner and senior manager must undergo enhanced due diligence using an independent PEP database, a list-based OFAC SDN search, consolidated UN Security Council consolidated list screening, and the PRC 'List of Untrustworthy Persons Subject to Joint Discipline' and MPS/MFA sanctions lists. Results must be archived, refreshed within 48 hours before notarization, and disclosed to the SAMR/PBOC upon request. Any PEP relationship or sanctions hit requires a risk decision by the compliance committee before formation proceeds.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and the local municipal SAMR online enterprise registration and name clearance service platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory name must be in Simplified Chinese characters following the four-tier format: administrative division + distinctive trade name (typically two or more characters, phonetically transliterated from the foreign parent if desired) + industry/business characteristic (e.g., medical device or sterile examination gloves) + legal form (Co., Ltd.). Traditional Chinese characters, Latin letters, Arabic numerals and foreign words are not permitted in the trade name except where separately authorized; a separate English trade name may be used for external export purposes but cannot replace the Simplified Chinese statutory name for SAMR clearance.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant receives a written decision stating the grounds. Within 60 days of receipt, the applicant may file administrative reconsideration with the next-higher SAMR or the same-level people's government; alternatively, the applicant may bring administrative litigation before the competent people's court within 6 months. The application must identify the registration authority, rejection decision number, proposed name, legal basis, and evidence of prior trademark rights. During the appeal, the applicant may simultaneously submit a revised alternative name online; if the original rejection is overturned, the original name is reinstated.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the registered address for a WFOE engaged in manufacturing and sale of sterile examination nitrile gloves. The tax authorities require an actual business premises satisfying the production, storage and quality-control needs of a medical PPE manufacturer, and the medical-device production license requires on-site inspection by the NMPA. Banks reject virtual-office addresses because KYC address matching fails and the commercial substance cannot be verified. A separate administrative office in a flexible workspace may be used for ancillary management functions only if the production site is separately registered and physically verifiable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: original lease or property ownership certificate, physical production line, on-site raw material and finished goods inventory, utilities invoices in the company name, employees present during working hours, and compliance with medical-device production quality system standards. Quantified risk: 70% likelihood of an unannounced municipal SAMR and tax-bureau inspection within the first 12 months; 90% likelihood if the registered address is a serviced office without a physical production site; 85% likelihood if and when the company applies for a medical-device production license or export VAT rebate.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAMR name clearance and company registration official fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory official fee; name clearance and company registration are free online government services in the PRC.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence, corporate structure review, and WFOE incorporation attorney fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: fixed fee based on complexity and scope of due diligence, up to 3,500 USD for a standard WFOE formation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of foreign parent corporate documents (Certificate of Incorporation, Good Standing, Board Resolution, Articles, Bank Letter)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff and prevailing local notary fees for multi-document packages.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille fees for foreign parent corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority for the Hague Apostille Convention in the issuing state (e.g., Secretary of State, Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille fees based on the foreign jurisdiction's published schedule.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Chinese translation of all authenticated corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translation agency / justice bureau notary office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per page plus certification stamp, typically 8 to 15 USD per page for technical and corporate records.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration and AML/CFT compliance screening (PEP, OFAC, UN, domestic watchlists)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent compliance service provider / AML screening database vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Subscription and per-search fee: fixed compliance service package for screening five UBOs and directors against all mandated lists.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Landlord under the commercial lease agreement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rent benchmark of approximately 1,500 USD per month; first quarter plus one-month deposit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise seal stamping (legal representative seal, financial seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and company chapter)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government-regulated service fee for standard company chop set.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank pre-account-opening KYC and relationship manager due diligence support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank service charge for KYC document review and foreign-exchange account pre-registration support.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed consulting fee for pre-incorporation gap analysis, license pathway, and quality-system readiness review.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 Revision), Articles 23 through 29 (company establishment), Article 30 (registered capital), Article 46 (board of directors), and Article 50 (executive officers); together with the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4, 13, and 15; and the Measures for the Administration of Incorporation Registration of Companies (SAMR Order No. 64, 2021), Articles 4, 8, and 15.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and its local, provincial, or municipal Market Regulation Administration; for foreign-invested entities, the local municipal Administration for Market Regulation with delegated foreign-investment registration authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association (AoA) of the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, together with the Company Incorporation Registration Application Form, and the Foreign Investment Filing Information Report submitted to the Ministry of Commerce or its local counterpart.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None; there is no statutory minimum paid-up capital under Chinese Company Law for a WFOE. However, for the manufacturing of sterile examination nitrile gloves under ISIC 3250, the relevant medical device licensure authority may expect paid-in capital sufficient to cover the production facility build-out, cleanroom validation, and clinical equivalence testing. In practice, a minimum paid-up capital of RMB 1,000,000 is recommended or may be required by the local medical device regulator to demonstrate operational capacity. Capital contributions may be made in cash, equipment, or technology, and must be fully paid within the time limit stated in the AoA, generally within 30 years for WFOEs but subject to any negative list restriction. No blocked escrow account requirement applies, but paid-in capital must be injected through the WFOE's foreign exchange capital account and verified by the designated receiving bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] WFOE LIMITED. RESOLVED, by unanimous written consent of the sole director/member or by the constituting shareholders acting in general meeting in accordance with the Articles of Association of the Company, as follows: 1. SUBSCRIPTION AND ALLOTMENT: That the registered capital of the Company be established at [AMOUNT IN RMB] divided into [NUMBER] shares of ordinary shares, designated as registered capital, with the foreign parent shareholder subscribing to [NUMBER] paid-in shares, representing one hundred percent of the equity interests, and that such subscription be accepted and the shares be allotted and issued fully paid or credited as fully paid in accordance with the contribution schedule set forth in the Articles of Association. 2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE: That the registered office of the Company be established at [SPECIFIC ADDRESS, LEVEL, ROOM, BUILDING, DISTRICT, CITY, PROVINCE, P.R. CHINA], and that the legal representative is hereby authorized to execute, affix the company seal, and submit to the Administration for Market Regulation all lease agreements, ownership certificates, landlord consent, and any supplementary filings required for the registration of the registered office; the registered office is approved as the statutory seat of the Company for service of process, tax registration, customs registration, and administrative notice purposes. 3. BANKING AND FISCAL AUTHORIZATION: That the Company open a RMB basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at [FINANCIAL INSTITUTION], that the legal representative and [NAME], general manager, be designated as joint signatories with two-person signing authority for checks, wire instructions, letters of credit, and treasury operations, and that such signatories be empowered to execute all account opening documents, resolutions, mandate letters, SWIFT and API banking forms, tax declaration agreements, foreign exchange registration forms, and payroll and payments instruments approved by the board of directors. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS: That [NAME] be and hereby is appointed as the legal representative and chairman of the board, that [NAME] be appointed as general manager, and that [NAME] be appointed as supervisor for a term of three years, all to serve until removed or re-appointed by the shareholder; the general manager is authorized to hire employees, sign contracts, obtain licenses, and bind the Company within the ordinary course of business, and the supervisor is authorized to examine company financials, supervise officers, and report to the shareholder as required by the Company Law. 5. STATUTORY REPRESENTATION AND GOVERNANCE: That the Company adopt its corporate governance framework as set out in the Articles of Association, including indemnification of directors and officers, standard audit procedures, quarterly board review sessions, and conflict-of-interest rules prohibiting related-party transactions without shareholder consent in accordance with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Foreign Investment Law. 6. AUTHORIZATION TO EXECUTE: That the legal representative and general manager, jointly or individually as provided for by the board, are hereby fully authorized and directed to execute and deliver all necessary documents, pay any applicable fees, obtain certificates, and take any acts as are necessary or advisable to carry out the above resolutions, including filing with the Market Regulation Administration, the tax authority, public security authority for company seal engraving, and the People's Bank of China for bank account codes. THIS RESOLUTION IS EFFECTIVE as of the date of its adoption and remains in full force unless revoked by a later shareholder resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Approval Name Registration and Business Scope Verification with SAMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation online portal via the 'National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System' and the local Administration for Market Regulation's enterprise registration network; for WFOE, also cross-checked with the Ministry of Commerce and local foreign investment service window under the Foreign Investment Negative List system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name in the format 'City + [Industry descriptor] + WFOE Limited Company' through the SAMR online name registration system or the local mobile application. Include the full proposed scope covering research, development, design, production and sale of sterile examination nitrile gloves, medical devices, and related accessories. Ensure the name is distinct from existing registered trademarks and enterprise names. The applicant must upload identification of the foreign shareholder, a power of attorney signed by the ultimate beneficial owner, and the planned business scope wording; if the business scope includes items restricted by the foreign investment negative list, such as any medical device segments requiring Chinese partners, the applicant must secure a specific approval or revise the scope to permissible wholly foreign owned activities.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name application form
Power of attorney from foreign investor to formation agent
Passport or business registration certificate of the foreign shareholder (notarized and apostilled, or notarized/legalized at the Chinese embassy/consulate in the jurisdiction where issued)
Chinese translation of foreign shareholder's registry certificate
Proposed Articles of Association draft with business scope in Chinese and English
Residential/commercial lease agreement or property right certificate for the intended registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity with an existing enterprise, file an administrative review or modify the name by adding a distinguishing numeric, geographic, or industry term; if the negative list blocks the scope, either revise the scope to remove the restricted item or apply for approval through the local commerce department's foreign-investment information reporting mechanism.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, Legalization, and Translation of Fundamental Corporate Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chinese embassy or consulate in the jurisdiction of the foreign investor; local judicial authentication office or notarization bureau; authorized translation agency qualified for certified Chinese translations; Ministry of Foreign Affairs or its consular legalization office if not a Hague Apostille member.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receiving the name pre-approval certificate with validity of six months, the foreign parent entity must execute the AoA, the sole shareholder resolution, the confirmation of the legal representative candidacy, and the first board resolution in either English or Chinese, then notarize and apostille or legalize the certified copies. All foreign language documents must be translated into Simplified Chinese by a qualified translation company and the translation must correspond to the original signed documents exactly. Civil notarization of the legal representative's passport copy and the financial institution verifier's power should be performed. If any document is signed in English, an English-Chinese bilingual version of the Articles of Association is prepared; any inconsistency is resolved in favor of the Chinese version for filing and registration, while the English version may be maintained as a non-regulatory corporate record.
required_dossiers: Name pre-approval certificate (issued by SAMR)
Notarized and legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign parent entity
Notarized and legalized certificate of Good Standing of the foreign parent entity (if older than one year)
Power of attorney executed by the foreign parent in favor of the designated Chinese legal representative and formation agent
Notarized and legalized shareholder resolution appointing the first director and legal representative
Apostilled or consular-legalized passport copy of the legal representative
Chinese translation of all non-Chinese documents with translator seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization or legalization is defective, apply for re-notarization in the foreign jurisdiction or obtain an amended apostille; if the Chinese translation contains material discrepancies, re-execute the translation and provide a statement of consistency; if the embassy refuses legalization, petition the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or employ the local chamber-of-commerce verification route accepted by SAMR.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formal Incorporation Filing and Issuance of the WFOE Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The local Market Regulation Administration (e.g., Shanghai Municipal Administration for Market Regulation, directly under SAMR), specifically the Enterprise Registration Division; for Internet-based filing, use the 'CA Digital Certificate' or bank-U-shield-based login on the local 'One-Stop Enterprise Registration Platform'.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After completing name reservation and document authentication, the formation agent must log into the local SAMR online enterprise registration system, complete the integration application form titled 'Application for Registration of a Wholly Foreign-Owned Limited Liability Company', and upload the scanned notarized AoA, lease contract, property right certificate, shareholder identity documents, list of directors and supervisors, legal representative appointment letter, and fingerprint/ID verification materials. If the registered address is in a free trade zone, apply through the FTZ one-stop window. The authority will review, approve, and issue the unified social credit code business license; the legal representative or authorized agent must provide the original documents for confirmation and collect the license at the service hall window. The SAMR system simultaneously transmits information to the tax bureau, public security, social security, and statistics bureaus for multi-department 'one application' registration and the issuance of the number, enabling follow-up establishment procedures.
required_dossiers: Original name pre-approval certificate
Articles of Association signed by all shareholders and legal representative
Lease agreement and certificate of ownership of the registered office, with the property owner's consent if subleasing
Certificate of the legal representative identity (passport for foreigner, resident ID or passport for Chinese national)
Dossier of the board members and supervisors with signed undertaking letters
Power of attorney for the formation agent and proof of authorized agent identity
Foreign investor's identity and notarized constitutional existence certificate
Consent of a Chinese landlord for the registered office if the landlord is not the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR queries the application due to incomplete lease contracts or capital contribution schedule, the applicant must file a supplementary notice through the online portal within 5 working days and correct the documents; if the application is suspended for inconsistency of the legal representative's identity, provide a new notarized passport copy or personal appearance at the registration window; if denied, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration with the local government or a de novo reapplication upon correcting the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Follow-Up: Seal Engraving, Tax Registration, Social Insurance, Public Security, Foreign Exchange and Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Public Security Bureau seal-engraving service center; Tax Service Hall of the State Taxation Administration; Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Customs (via the Customs General Administration); State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) branch; and the chosen commercial bank as an authorized bank for foreign exchange and RMB accounts.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after obtaining the business license, apply for official company seals (company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal, invoice seal) at a licensed seal engraving company approved by the public security bureau; register the seals with the police. Then complete tax registration by logging in to the electronic tax bureau or through the SAMR one-stop registration, including the tax payer type (general taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer), payroll information, and accounting system. The company must then open a basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at a designated bank, submitting the business license, original seals, articles of association, legal representative passport, and shareholder resolution; the bank's SAFE system will automatically register the foreign exchange receipt qualification. Thereafter, apply for customs registration with the General Administration of Customs using the unified social credit code, obtain the customs declaration and inspection unit registration, and complete the foreign trade operator filing via the Ministry of Commerce's Foreign Trade Development Bureau system. If the company will hire employees, additionally register social insurance, statistical reporting, and a personal income tax withholding system; based on business license scope, apply for the medical device production and registration licenses as required before commencement of manufacture.
required_dossiers: Original business license (unified social credit code)
Approval letter for seal engraving from the public security service platform
Company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal and invoice seal (already engraved)
Legal representative passport and second officer ID
Bank account opening permit or online bank account information
Articles of Association and first board resolution
Foreign exchange capital account application form with SAFE-required declaration
Foreign trade operator filing form if importing gloves dipping materials or exporting products
Customs registration form if export is planned
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects foreign exchange capital account opening due to incomplete anti-money-laundering customer due diligence, provide the class-of-business certificate, beneficial owner register, and board resolution; if the tax registration encounters overdue penalties because of post-license timeline, file an administrative grace explanation with the tax service hall and pay any minor late fee; if SAFE withholding is queried, re-submit the foreign investor's audited financials or a written representation of source of funds; if customs registration is delayed, use the provisional import/export procedure for machinery and apply for expedited registration in the customs service system.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and the provincial (e.g., Shanghai) Medical Products Administration; local Administration for Market Regulation for industrial product production licensing; Ministry of Emergency Management and local Civil Defense/Emergency Management Bureau for fire safety.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Production License (People's Republic of China Medical Device Production License) and, if applicable for sterile examination gloves sold as sterile medical devices, a Medical Device Registration Certificate for the product; additionally, the Foreign Trade Operating License under the Ministry of Commerce for export.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) and the local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report for a medical glove dipping manufacturing project involving chemical processing of nitrile polymer, compounding, dipping-line emissions, wastewater treatment, and hazardous waste generation; likely listed under the 'Catalog of Classified Administration of Environmental Impact Assessments for Construction Projects' requiring an EIA report for chemical synthetic rubber or latex dipping processes; if the production output is moderate, an EIA Registration Form may be accepted by the local MEE for formulated production volumes, but for ISIC 3250 manufacture of rubber gloves with chemical crosslinking and surface chlorination or synthetic polymer use, the highest applicable full EIA report is required; the project must obtain construction phase emissions approval and discharge permit; if the facility is located in an industrial park with central wastewater treatment, the EIA may be simplified to a report table.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard GB 8978-1996 or local standards (e.g., Shanghai Integrated Sewage Discharge Standard DB31/445) including COD ≤ 500 mg/L (or ≤300 mg/L if connected to municipal system with tightened standard), BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen ≤ 45 mg/L unless local stricter limits apply, total suspended solids ≤ 400 mg/L general discharge threshold, pH 6-9, petroleum-like substances ≤ 20 mg/L, nitrile-related chemical oxygen demand and zinc ≤ 2 mg/L if zinc salts are used, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) compliant with the Emission Standard for Volatile Organic Compounds from Industrial Enterprises GB 37822-2019, with facility VOCs emission limits of ≤ 50 mg/m3 for maximum allowable mass concentration in any facility, and non-methane total hydrocarbon emissions ≤ 60 mg/m3 under hood or ≤ 120 mg/m3 for fugitive leaks, as per local implementation; hazardous waste storage in compliance with the Hazardous Waste Identification Standard, with containerization, labeling and disposal via licensed hazardous waste treatment units within 90 days of generation, and wastewater discharge permits under the Pollution Discharge Permit Management Provisions (Ministry of Ecology and Environment Decree No. 48) requiring an emission permit with permitted quality, volume, and monitoring requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certification: obtain a fire inspection and acceptance certificate or a fire safety compliance opinion from the local Emergency Management Bureau/Fire & Rescue Department upon completion of new construction or major remodeling; maintain automatic fire alarm systems, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, exit signs, and approved evacuation routes for dipping-line industrial buildings. Structural load inspections: certified structural engineer or construction quality inspection unit's report demonstrating that building floors can support the dipping line, drying ovens, tanks, and chemical storage; in provinces requiring it, obtain a building inspection report from a qualifying civil engineering lab. Occupational safety clearance: obtain registration under the Work Safety Law, prepare a workplace OHS risk assessment, implement personal protective equipment, chemical safety data sheets, nitrile glove dipping SOPs, nitrile dust control, ergonomic controls, and file a hazard notification with the local Emergency Management Bureau; for controlled chemicals such as curing agents and accelerators, obtain a dangerous chemical use permit or record-filing under the Regulation on Safety Management of Hazardous Chemicals; for sterile medical gloves, obtain the NMPA GMP compliance certificate or self-inspection declaration, and sterile product release testing must be performed in a licensed microbiology laboratory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic tax administration is performed through the official Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) platform under each provincial-level STA office.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a WFOE: (1) incorporate as a limited liability company with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and receive the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), an 18-character identifier that is the legally recognized taxpayer identification number for tax purposes; (2) complete integrated tax registration through the multi-item linkage (one-stop) registration, whereby SAMR registration data is automatically transmitted to the State Taxation Administration and tax authorities open taxpayer files for Corporate Income Tax (CIT), VAT, payroll withholding, stamp tax, and local surcharges; (3) after the business license is issued, log into the Electronic Tax Bureau using the USCC, set up the digital tax password/certificate, and complete any supplemental registrations (e.g., export tax refund filing, general taxpayer status election, bank/financial account reporting) within the statutory registration period; (4) for a foreign non-resident enterprise that does not establish a WFOE but has China-source income, the payer applies withholding registration and obtains a tax identification number for non-resident enterprises (or records the non-resident's home-country TIN) in accordance with the STA's non-resident enterprise tax registration procedures; (5) after obtaining the USCC, the taxpayer must report changes, annual filing, and invoice issuance through the Electronic Tax Bureau.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - resident WFOE limited liability company taxed on worldwide income; no pass-through treatment is available; territorial-zone exemptions are not assumed for a standard WFOE outside a special tax-exempt zone.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. China does not provide a U.S.-style check-the-box classification or hybrid-mismatch entity election. The WFOE is automatically a resident enterprise for Corporate Income Tax. Available VAT elections are limited to small-scale taxpayer status (annual taxable sales at or below RMB 5,000,000) versus general taxpayer status, and the filing of export VAT refund/exemption preference, neither of which changes the entity-level CIT classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) administered by the State Taxation Administration, supplemented by urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, and local education surcharges calculated on VAT paid.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for tax registration: every WFOE must register for VAT from the date its business license is issued. A simplified 'small-scale taxpayer' regime is available when annual taxable sales are at or below RMB 5,000,000; a general taxpayer registration/election is mandatory when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT invoices must be issued through the STA's invoice control system. Under the nationwide Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice (FDEI) pilot, electronic invoices are generated on the official Electronic Tax Bureau platform, assigned anti-fraud digital stamps and unique codes, and cleared by the tax authority in near-real-time through the electronic invoice service platform. Paper VAT special invoices and VAT ordinary invoices remain lawful only when issued through the integrated invoice management system and reported digitally to the STA; all invoice red-letter/credit reversals must be processed through the same electronic platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods by a VAT-registered WFOE qualifies for 0% VAT if the goods are actually exported from China customs territory and declared to customs under the export goods procedure; the exporter must have valid foreign-trade operator qualification and a customs export registration code; the sale must be a genuine cross-border transaction with ownership and risk transferred to the overseas buyer; and the exporter must collect the foreign exchange proceeds and retain the full export documentation bundle. Qualifying offshore services consumed abroad may also be zero-rated under the cross-border service zero-rating rules, but the current scope covers exported physical sterile nitrile gloves.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration) as cleared and stamped/electronically verified by the General Administration of Customs
Bill of Lading or equivalent multimodal/air transport document evidencing carriage of the gloves to the foreign destination
Commercial export invoice and signed export sales contract
Packing list and related loading/weight documents
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank-issued foreign exchange receipt record proving repatriation of export proceeds
VAT export invoice or ordinary commercial invoice issued for the export sale
Foreign Trade Operator registration record and customs export registration code
Medical device export qualification/sales certificate for the sterile examination gloves, if required
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to risk-based post-clearance review by the tax authority. If the exporter fails to repatriate export proceeds within the statutory period, cannot substantiate the customs declaration, or is found to have obtained a VAT refund through false documentation, the tax authority will disallow the 0% rate, require repayment of the refunded VAT, and impose daily late-payment interest at 0.05% of the overdue amount. Administrative penalties range from 0.5 to 5 times the evaded tax under the Tax Collection Administration Law. Intentional fraudulent export tax refund cases are referred to criminal enforcement under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, with possible imprisonment, fines, forfeiture of refunds, suspension of export rebate qualifications, and downgrading of customs credit status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Chinese onshore FX regime follows a controlled current account convertibility model for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise. Routine export settlement, import payments, operational expenses and trade-related working capital movements are generally executable through SAFE-designated tier-1 banks without a separate central bank approval per transaction, but every movement is subject to real-business background verification and the matching of foreign exchange receipts to customs declarations, invoices and shipping documents. Capital account items remain strictly controlled: registered capital injection, equity transfer proceeds, cross-border loans, disposal of owner-occupied real estate and dividend repatriation all require SAFE registration and subsequent bank-level verification. A WFOE manufacturing sterile nitrile gloves must complete a Foreign Direct Investment base registration before any inbound capital enters, and the shareholder's registered capital arrives in an onshore foreign exchange capital account where it must be used exclusively for the stated business purposes, never silently recycled into securities or unauthorized intercompany lending. Profit remittance is permitted only after a statutory audit, full tax settlement, corporate income tax payment and withholding tax payment on the distributing entity, board approval and submission of the audited financial statements to the remitting bank. Export proceeds no longer face a mandatory surrender ratio, but they must be repatriated into a Chinese bank account and verified on the trade monitoring platform within the prescribed window. The framework is operationally stable for a genuine medical PPE exporter with complete documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export foreign currency receipts must be repatriated into the WFOE's designated domestic receiving account within 180 calendar days from the date of export customs declaration under the export trade foreign exchange settlement and verification regime. There is no mandatory conversion ratio to RMB after SAFE abolished the compulsory foreign exchange surrender requirement in 2012, so 100% of proceeds may be retained in the foreign-currency account or voluntarily converted into RMB at commercial rates. For each export batch, the WFOE must submit the invoice, customs declaration, bill of lading, packing list and payment receipt into the trade monitoring platform within 15 business days after receipt of funds; failure to repatriate or verify triggers a rate-based penalty, downgrading of trade facilitation status and restriction on future export settlement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account and Basic Operational Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Export Trade Receivables Account
Basic Operational Currency Account and Import Settlement Account
Cross-Border RMB and FX Operating Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Revolut Business, Wise Business, Airwallex and similar global neo-banks cannot legally serve a mainland WFOE as its primary settlement bank because they do not hold a PBOC-issued onshore payment institution license and are outside the SAFE foreign exchange verification framework. They may be used as ancillary collection gateways for overseas e-commerce customers, but they cannot perform SAFe registration, export declaration matching, capital verification or import settlement. The WFOE must clear all cross-border flows through a licensed onshore Chinese commercial bank; any fintech service must route back into the licensed bank and cannot replace it for corporate treasury operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative or a designated local Authorized Signatory must appear physically in-branch at the tier-1 bank during onboarding. Remote-only video KYC without an in-person meeting is not acceptable under prevailing PBOC anti-money laundering practice. If the legal representative is outside China, the bank may accept a notarized Power of Attorney legalized by the Chinese embassy or consulate, and the locally appointed representative must appear in person with the original POA, passport, board resolution and updated incorporation documents. The ultimate beneficial owner may attend a supplementary video interview, but the executing officer must complete an in-person interview at the recommended branch and a site visit to the registered manufacturing address is normally required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque offshore shareholding chain where the WFOE is owned by a BVI or Cayman intermediate vehicle, making the ultimate beneficial owner and source of wealth difficult to identify.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized certificate of incumbency for every offshore entity in the ownership chain, audited holding-company financial statements, ultimate beneficial owner passport copies and permanent-address proof, source-of-wealth declarations, SAFE foreign exchange registration application naming every shareholder above 10%, and the WFOE's Articles of Association translated and legalized into English.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lump-sum registered capital injection immediately before initial trade raises a round-tripping or layering red flag, especially if the remitter bank is in a low-tax jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source bank statements for at least six months, the investor's audited financial statements or tax returns proving legitimate source of funds, the WFOE feasibility study, signed shareholder resolution and capital injection timetable, board minutes authorizing the remittance, and a CPA-issued capital verification report prepared after the funds are settled in China.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering in the sterile nitrile glove transaction, where over- or under-invoicing can divert export value away from the real economy or coat proceeds through mispriced medical disposables.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original sales contract, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, customs export declaration, proof of shipment inspection, the export exchange settlement sheet, unit-price benchmark reports for similar ISO 13485 nitrile examination gloves, and a pricing reasonableness explanation signed by the finance controller.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, denial-list or final-destination concern when glove shipments are routed through transshipment ports or invoiced to countries adjacent to sanctioned jurisdictions, raising diversion and prohibited-party risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed denied-party screening report from the bank-recognized compliance database, exporter's internal AML/export-control certificate, final end-use attestation from the customer, full transportation routing and bill-of-lading chain, cargo classification opinion from a licensed customs broker confirming the medical glove HS code, and the relevant export licensing badge to prove no dual-use overlap.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder remits registered capital via SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's onshore foreign exchange capital account at a Chinese tier-1 bank using the legally permitted foreign direct investment purpose code. Every inbound capital remittance must be lodged under the still-valid SAFE Foreign Investment Registration Certificate and the bank must submit the settlement into SAFE's digital monitoring platform on the same service day. After crediting, the WFOE must compile the capital verification file using the bank settlement voucher, shareholder remittance instruction and underlying investment agreement; a licensed Chinese certified public accountant then issues a capital verification report. For operating RMB needs, the WFOE applies to convert foreign currency at the receiving bank and must preserve the conversion voucher for later tax and audit reviews. HSBC or any standard overseas remitter should include the beneficiary bank's SWIFT code, the WFOE's SAFE registration number and a remittance reference citing the registered capital purpose code to ensure smooth inbound clearance and customs-verification matching.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are executed through established clearing rails: SWIFT MT103 is used for open-account post-shipment payments and small-value working capital transfers to overseas suppliers; Commercial Letters of Credit are issued through the WFOE's Chinese bank as the issuing bank for large raw-material imports and machinery purchases, with advising or confirmation at the beneficiary's bank; Documentary Collections are used for low-risk one-off transactions where the seller releases documents against payment or acceptance. Every outbound export or import payment must match the customs declaration, invoice, bill of lading and foreign exchange purpose code on the trade monitoring platform, and the bank will verify the underlying contract before releasing US dollars, euros or cross-border RMB. For payments to China, cross-border RMB can be cleared over the CIPS network as an alternative to SWIFT, improving efficiency while preserving the same SAFE reporting obligations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: SAFE-approved deliverable RMB/FX forward contracts with tenors matched to verified current-account trade receivables and payables
FX swap agreements for near-term working capital conversion without speculative leverage
Plain-vanilla FX call and put options with premium and strike amounts tied to an approved trade order pipeline
Currency interest-rate swaps on underlying foreign-currency borrowing used in the WFOE's banking relationship
Cross-currency swaps for long-term foreign shareholder loans or import settlement hedges
Onshore books cannot legally book offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs); any NDF remains a prohibited speculative instrument for the WFOE unless explicitly approved under a special SAFE pilot.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report / Annual Information Publicity Filing of Enterprise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 immediately following the reporting fiscal year; reflects data as at December 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by June 30 results in inclusion on the Abnormal Operations List within 10 working days; submission of the overdue report triggers removal from that list. Persistent non-reporting for three consecutive years leads to placement on the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, credit blacklisting, prohibition of the legal representative from acting as a director or legal representative of any other enterprise, and ultimately administrative revocation or strike-off of the registration; false or suppressed report content may attract fines of up to RMB 20,000 plus rectification orders.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and local commerce authorities through the integrated joint annual report platform with SAMR
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 immediately following the reporting fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or untruthful reporting is recorded in the Foreign Investment Information Credit System; enforcement includes rectification orders, administrative penalties under the PRC Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures, restriction on capital-account foreign exchange settlement, denial of government procurement and preferential treatment, and for persistent default, cancellation of registration status or administrative strike-off of the WFOE.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Filing and Settlement (Enterprise Income Tax Final Reconciliation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration and local tax bureaus
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual settlement filing due by May 31 immediately following the calendar or fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per calendar day on any unpaid tax, plus a procedural penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 for non-filing. Understatement of taxable income or tax due may trigger a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; intentional tax evasion exposes the entity and responsible officers to criminal liability, freezing of bank accounts, publication of tax credit violations, and administrative revocation of the business license after persistent non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size-based de minimis exemption exists for foreign-invested enterprises: every WFOE, regardless of balance sheet total, revenue, or headcount, must undergo an annual independent certified public accountant (CPA) audit and submit the audit report with the annual information filing. By analogy, listed companies and public-interest entities are audited with no turnover threshold exemption; financial institutions, insurance companies, and securities firms are audited irrespective of asset size under the applicable regulators. For a domestic non-FIE limited liability company, audit becomes mandatory only in circumstances such as public offering, liquidation, regulatory order, or shareholder request under PRC Company Law; however, the WFOE operating in medical PPE manufacturing is always subject to the statutory FIE audit obligation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/CAS), issued by the Ministry of Finance and substantially converged with IFRS; small enterprises may apply the Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises for Small Enterprises, and the WFOE, if economically significant, should use the full ASBE framework. Tax compliance in the annual CIT settlement adjusts accounting book profit to taxable income in accordance with the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law and its implementing regulations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China adopts an annual UBO and actual-controller disclosure protocol through the Enterprise Annual Report, requiring the latest beneficial ownership, shareholder, equity transfer, capital contribution, and control chain information as at December 31 to be filed with SAMR. Any shareholding transfer, capital increase or decrease, change of actual controller, or alteration of beneficial owners must be registered with the competent Administration for Market Regulation within 30 days of the occurrence; failure to register the change cannot bind third parties in good faith and constitutes a compliance violation carrying rectification notices, fines, and adverse credit records. The WFOE must also maintain an internally updated register of members and actual controllers accessible for inspection, and file supporting amendments before executing annual report disclosures.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 200 to USD 600 per year for a shared virtual registered address in tier-2 and tier-3 cities; USD 1,000 to USD 3,500 per year for a dedicated physical registered office and licensed corporate/registered agent in tier-1 commercial centers; outsourced corporate secretarial packages range from USD 800 to USD 2,500 per annum.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 to USD 8,000 for a WFOE with annual turnover up to USD 10 million; USD 8,000 to USD 20,000 for turnover between USD 10 million and USD 50 million; USD 20,000 and above for large-scale manufacturing WFOEs requiring consolidated audits, inventory count support, transfer pricing documentation, and environmental or medical device compliance examinations.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 25%; reduced 15% for High and New Technology Enterprises (CIT Law Art. 28); small low-profit enterprises may enjoy a 20% statutory rate with the current reduced-taxable-income preferential policy creating an effective 5% rate on qualifying first RMB 3 million of taxable income; Hainan Free Trade Port encourages industries at 15%; R&D expenses are eligible for a 100% additional deduction; qualified high-tech/small-technology enterprises can carry losses forward 10 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (A-Class), Form A100000 with applicable supplemental schedules (e.g., A105000 special tax adjustments, A108010 foreign tax credit); filed via the State Taxation Administration electronic tax filing system (e-Tax).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual reconciliation, with quarterly provisional prepayment returns during the tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due within five months after the close of the fiscal year (for a calendar-year WFOE, on or before May 31 of the next year); quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after each quarter-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from sale of sterile nitrile gloves, including domestic and export sales after trade discounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: As a PRC resident WFOE, declare worldwide income. Attribute export revenue to the taxpayer only where the invoiced buyer and economic substance confirm the PRC manufacturer is the true principal. Intercompany export sales to offshore distributors must satisfy arm's-length pricing and be supported by the China TP documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold: raw nitrile latex, compounding chemicals, packaging, direct labor, factory overhead and depreciation of the high-speed dipping production line.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capitalize and deduct inventory cost only with actual receipt and customs documentation. If latex or materials are purchased from foreign related suppliers, the cost must be substantiated by CUP or another accepted method; inflated intra-group raw-material costs are a classic audit target and must be reconciled to the TP file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-CIT current-year business levies, including urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, stamp duty, real estate tax, and vehicle-related taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: VAT cannot be deducted in the EIT return; export VAT exemption/refund amounts must be excluded properly. Foreign-sourced withholding taxes are not booked as surcharges here but as tax credits, if any.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales commissions, freight, insurance, certification/registration fees for sterile medical device exports, marketing expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses for distribution through non-resident agents must be ordinary and necessary, evidenced by actual services. Payments to non-resident service providers may trigger WHT or be recharacterized as royalties if they are not true procurement/distribution services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General overhead: management salaries, office rent, IT, professional fees and head-office allocations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Parent-company management fees are not automatically deductible; the WFOE must show that the fee is for actual services, an arm's-length amount, and is not a hidden dividend. Contractual, testimonial and cost-support documents are required. Non-resident intercompany service fees require withholding and treaty-benefit analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest on bank and intercompany borrowings, bank charges, exchange gains/losses, and other financing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 2:1 debt-to-equity thin capitalization limit for non-financial WFOEs; related-party interest exceeding that ratio is non-deductible unless the arm's-length plus substance tests are met. Interest paid to non-resident lenders is subject to 10% WHT (treaty rate if a valid TRC is provided).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 / Line 10: Operating Profit and Reconciliation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit before non-operating items, adjusted for investment income, fair-value changes, asset impairment, then non-operating income/expense to arrive at total accounting profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Aggregate all China- and foreign-source profit. On this reconciliation line, exclude items that are statutorily exempt or non-taxable (e.g., qualifying intercompany dividends), and add back disallowed transactions. The non-resident owner's characterization does not change the WFOE's status as a Chinese resident taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 / Line 15+: Taxable Income and Foreign Withholding Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss carryforwards, special adjustments, tax-exempt income, and deductions; then tax payable, relief, and foreign tax credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute CIT at the applicable rate; if foreign tax credits are claimed for taxes paid from outbound investment, attach Schedule A108010. The same return environment must include or cross-reference withholding schedules for dividends, interest and royalties paid to non-resident shareholders/lenders, quoting the applicable DTA rate only where the non-resident has furnished a TRC and beneficial-ownership declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fine up to RMB 2,000 (RMB 2,000-10,000 for serious cases). Late tax payment accrues a 0.05% per-day surcharge. Fraudulent underreporting or false deduction is penalized at 50%-500% of the underpaid tax. Criminal tax evasion is prosecuted under Criminal Law Art.201; unpaid tax above statutory thresholds can lead to imprisonment and additional fines. The tax authority may impose exit bans on responsible directors for unpaid tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax on dividends distributed by a PRC resident WFOE to a non-resident enterprise; many DTAs reduce this to 5% when the beneficial owner is a treaty resident company holding at least 25% of the WFOE's share capital.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the treaty-jurisdiction tax authority for the year of payment; (ii) complete a treaty-benefit self-assessment demonstrating it is the beneficial owner of the income and does not enjoy treaty benefits through a conduit arrangement; (iii) deliver the TRC and written declaration to the Chinese withholding agent before the dividend is paid; and (iv) retain the documentary package for at least five years. The withholding agent then withholds at the treaty rate and reports the reduced rate in the electronic withholding return. If the statutory rate was applied because documents were incomplete, the non-resident may file for a refund within three years through the competent tax authority.
